note: Features seen on the reference simulator (feature names only, in our words) and where our own implementation lives in js/sim.js. The weekly check (tools/sim/ROUTINE.md) compares the site against this list and builds anything new as original code.

features.ref: Component palette in categories (external, networking, compute, messaging, data, AI agents) with search
features.ours: Build tab: 37 components in 7 groups with search (SIM_K, SIM_CAT), including data engineering parts: Kafka, CDC, Connect sink, stream processor, Spark, Airflow, dbt, quality checks, schema registry, DLQ, lake, catalog, warehouse, Trino, OLAP, serving store, feature store, vector store, embedding model, LLM API

features.ref: Custom component with your own latency and capacity
features.ours: Custom box; every box's capacity, latency and cost can be edited

features.ref: Infinite canvas, drag and drop, zoom, pan
features.ours: SVG canvas with pointer drag (mouse and touch), pan, wheel and pinch zoom, fit

features.ref: Curved wires between components
features.ours: Bezier wires: drag from a box's right dot, or tap the dot then a box; keyboard Enter works too

features.ref: Undo and redo
features.ours: Toolbar and Cmd/Ctrl+Z, Shift+Cmd/Ctrl+Z

features.ref: Auto layout and layout zones
features.ours: Auto layout by depth from the sources; zones by category

features.ref: Multi-select
features.ours: Not built: single selection with arrow-key nudging

features.ref: Traffic simulation at a set rate, play, pause, reset, speed
features.ours: SIM.step fluid model, Run tab: play, pause, reset, 1x/2x/4x, traffic multiplier, per-source rate

features.ref: Live readouts on each box and a top status bar (RPS, p99, errors, bottlenecks)
features.ours: Box readouts (rate, p99, load bar, lag), status strip (in, p50, p99, errors, lag, hot spots, cost)

features.ref: Full metrics view with latency history and bottleneck callouts
features.ours: Metrics tab: latency, throughput, errors and backlog charts, hot spots with the reason

features.ref: Failure injection in groups: network, infrastructure, traffic, data layer, application, dependency
features.ours: Break tab: 19 failures in 5 groups, including data ones (bad records, breaking schema change, backfill, hot partition, connector lag, broker lost)

features.ref: Rough cloud cost per box
features.ours: Cost tab: per box and total per month, cost per million requests

features.ref: Blueprint library with category and level filters
features.ours: Scenarios tab: 16 starting designs tied to modules, filters by module and level

features.ref: Practice scenarios
features.ours: Each scenario is a challenge with goals; Check my design runs it headless and grades it (SIM.grade), passes saved in S.sim.done

features.ref: Suggestions and architecture notes
features.ours: Review tab: suggestions (single points of failure, idle consumers, no DLQ, no registry) and recognised patterns

features.ref: Trace a request through the flow
features.ours: Run tab: Trace one request, highlights the path and lists hop latency

features.ref: Export JSON and PNG, import JSON
features.ours: Save and share menu: JSON, PNG, import

features.ref: Share link (stored on their server for 7 days)
features.ours: Share link carries the design in the URL, no server; imported designs are cleaned (simClean)

features.ref: Guided tour and tutorial
features.ours: Inline hints in each tab; the first scenarios are the tutorial

features.ref: Create a design with AI from a template
features.ours: Not built
